verdict.rationale: YYLO lets the user pick the agent explicitly with `--subagent claude`. Its site says it delegates work 'across agents and models', and benchmark runs bind 'model selectors' before execution. Together these imply the user can choose a model rather than having one picked automatically, but no evidence shows how to do it for normal tasks. Missing for 10: any documented automatic-model-selection mode to switch away from, a documented flag or config for pinning a specific model in regular runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
